entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, this is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF987-5542.

Okay, let me just pull that up for you... VF987-5542. I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered six days ago. I can certainly help with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this thing is just way too tight. I need an exchange.

I understand completely. The Aero Race line does have a very compressive, performance fit. Since you're well within the 90-day window, that's absolutely no problem. We can definitely get that exchange processed for you right away.

It's simple. I can initiate the exchange for you right now. As you're a VIP member with us, I'll also waive the return shipping fee and upgrade the shipping on your new jersey to complimentary 2-day express. What size would you like instead?
A Large. The express shipping is fine, thank you.

Perfect. I've just processed the exchange for a size Large. You'll receive an email in the next two minutes with a pre-paid return label. Just print that out, attach it to the package with the original jersey, and drop it off. As soon as the carrier scans it, we'll ship out the new one. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Great. Thanks for your call, and have a wonderful day.
